poly_list_chi_bounded.note: Polynomially chi-bounded in list form: one natural coefficient list (lowest degree first) chosen BEFORE the graphs bounds chi by its Horner evaluation at omega over the whole class (a per-graph choice would be vacuous). No guard: the empty list bounds only chi = 0. Non-vacuous (graphs with at most one vertex), hereditary along inclusion, a bound in the arbitrary-function sense, and defeated by unbounded chi at bounded omega; equivalent to the normal form c * omega ^ d over the naturals (poly_forms, the omega = 0 corner included).
